title: PosBulkSupplementalTagStatus

job_id.description: A value that identifies a bulk supplemental tag request.

processing_complete.description: True if this job processing is done (successful or not), false otherwise.

status.description: Status of a menu entity supplemental tag operation.

reason.description: Additional details that pertain to the status of the operation.

entity_ids.description: A list of external IDs that were part of the associated request.

items.description: A list of external IDs that were part of the associated request.

merchant_id.description: This field can either be the Grubhub ID for the merchant, or if an external ID is provided, it represents the external ID of the merchant.

description: Describes the state (completed or not) of a bulk supplemental tag operation request together with its state (successful or not).
